title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Invocation of Process…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a vulnerability where a low privileged local attacker could exploit an invocation of process using visible sensitive information, potentially leading to information exposure. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 2.5 and does not affect integrity or availability.
